newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: NICARAGUA JULY INFLATION AT 1.51 PCT -CENTRAL BANK.
newsitem.headline: NICARAGUA JULY INFLATION AT 1.51 PCT -CENTRAL BANK.

text.p: Nicaragua's July consumer price index rose 1.51 percent, its second-largest monthly increase this year, the country's central bank said on Tuesday.
In June the consumer price index rose 1.97 percent, it said.
Accumulated inflation for the first seven months of 1997 was 4.66 percent, compared with 5.67 percent in the same period the previous year.
In the 12 months to the end of July, consumer prices rose 11.01 percent compared with 11.08 percent in the year-ago period.
The government said the cost of its basic basket of household items rose to $151 in July from $150.13 in June.
